name: Serape
description: A Saltillo serape: bright horizontal bands, each row a broad stripe and a zigzag ribbon, the colors stepping down the cloth.

code.style: --rule: ( --k0: @pd(@p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5))); --k1: @pd(@p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5))); --k2: @pd(@p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5))); --k3: @pd(@p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5))); --k4: @pd(@p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5))); --a: @match((y) % 5 == 0, @var(--k0), (y) % 5 == 1, @var(--k1), (y) % 5 == 2, @var(--k2), (y) % 5 == 3, @var(--k3), @var(--k4)); --b: @match((y + 2) % 5 == 0, @var(--k0), (y + 2) % 5 == 1, @var(--k1), (y + 2) % 5 == 2, @var(--k2), (y + 2) % 5 == 3, @var(--k3), @var(--k4)); --h: @match(y % 3 == 0, 44%, y % 3 == 1, 28%, 36%); @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; top: 0; height: @var(--h); background-color: @p(@var(--a)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; top: 56%; height: 32%; background-color: @var(--b); -webkit-clip-path: polygon(0.0% 0.0%, 25.0% 60.0%, 50.0% 0.0%, 75.0% 60.0%, 100.0% 0.0%, 100.0% 40.0%, 75.0% 100.0%, 50.0% 40.0%, 25.0% 100.0%, 0.0% 40.0%); clip-path: polygon(0.0% 0.0%, 25.0% 60.0%, 50.0% 0.0%, 75.0% 60.0%, 100.0% 0.0%, 100.0% 40.0%, 75.0% 100.0%, 50.0% 40.0%, 25.0% 100.0%, 0.0% 40.0%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
